specs.英文简介: The FED Atlas (also referred to in some places as the FED-11, though the camera itself is not marked with this) is a 35 mm coupled rangefinder camera, made by FED in 1967-71.[http://www.photohistory.ru/index.php?pid=1207248177863260 FED-10 and 'Fed-11 Atlas'] at Georgi Abramov's [http://www.photohistory.ru/index.php photohistory.ru].
